description:
In this newest update for the TCM model, I have introduced a new scoring logic, a physics and scenario engine and significantly improved the accuracy and how data is seen, from my new very powerful TCM engine, which has been completely re built from the ground up, with many and man new ways of data processing and how it is shown and understood, simply, I made the brain of the TCM model much smarter. 

But, unfortunately due to me making a much more powerful engine, which consumes much more API credits than before, Ive had to scale down on how many models I use everyday and how many days there is. Here are all the changes:

- I have scaled down on how many days there is available, with it going down from 4 to 3 days.
- I have reduced the amount of model runs per day, with day 1 having all 6, then day 2 having 4 and day 3 having 3 model runs

I will continue to try to optimize the amount of usage which is used, but still trying to keep the same amount of quality in the model. I will continue t try to increase from 3 to 4 days and possibly 5 days, and then if I am able to expand into Europe. But Unfortunately, with the expansion to Europe, it will cost even more to run the model. I may scale down much further if needed or start charging money for the European expansion, but I wouldn't do that, so dont worry.

This new update will launch today (04.07.2026), with more to come later in the month and later on in the year, with more surprises o come in the winter, I wonder what my model could do in the winter for a forecast?
